title: Indoor Condition Observation Series — Enrollment Administration
summary: Current protocol-administration record for the seven-day Indoor Condition Observation Series and its public eligibility screen.

sections.title: ADMINISTRATIVE RECORD
sections.body:
**Study reference:** ST-26-014

**Protocol revision:** 2.1

**Responsible unit:** Participant Programs Office

**Administrative state:** Participation open

**Effective date:** 2026-07-28

**Personnel record:** Role-only working copy

sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:
**Objective:** Maintain the approved public protocol, eligibility questions, and seven-day observation instructions for ordinary indoor condition observations.

**Scope limitation:** Preliminary screening issues a temporary reference only. This administrative copy contains no applicant identity, contact information, exact location, or submitted observation values.

sections.title: METHOD & OBSERVATIONS
sections.body:
**Administrative review:** Confirmed the study question, three daily observation windows, fixed response categories, and the optional use of a household temperature or humidity display.

**Observation:** Eligibility language requests broad schedule, room, and equipment categories only. Health, address, photograph, recording, and device-telemetry requests remain excluded.

sections.title: DISPOSITION
sections.body:
**Disposition:** Continue the current public eligibility screen and protocol materials.

**Next review:** Confirm wording and schedule assumptions before the next protocol revision.

**Review status:** Current materials approved for public display.
